description: Submit one already-signed XRPL transaction to the network. `tx_blob` must be the complete signed transaction encoded as hexadecimal; obtain it from the caller's local signing step, normally after `n9t2_xrpl_prepare_transaction`. This action mutates ledger state when the transaction is accepted into the XRPL network and must never receive private keys, seeds, or wallet secrets. `fail_hard` forwards rippled's option and defaults to false; when true, a transaction that fails locally is not retried or relayed. The result preserves the raw submit response, including `engine_result` and `engine_result_message` and, when returned, `accepted`, `queued`, `validated`, and transaction data. Submission is tentative; use `n9t2_xrpl_get_transaction` with the returned transaction hash to confirm validated-ledger inclusion. Invalid hexadecimal or XRPL-rejected blobs return an error.

fail_hard.description: Forward rippled's fail_hard option. When true, a transaction that fails locally is not retried or relayed to other servers. Defaults to false.
fail_hard.title: Fail Hard

tx_blob.description: Complete signed XRPL transaction encoded as hexadecimal. The caller must sign locally before sending it to N9T2.
tx_blob.title: Tx Blob

name: n9t2_xrpl_submit_transaction

custody.description: Non-custodial confirmation. N9T2 never receives, stores, or uses the caller's private keys, seeds, or wallet secrets.
custody.title: Custody

signed_blob_submitted.description: True when the validated hexadecimal tx_blob was forwarded to the XRPL submit method.
signed_blob_submitted.title: Signed Blob Submitted

submission.description: Raw XRPL rippled submit response. Inspect engine_result and engine_result_message for the tentative submission outcome; the response may also include accepted, queued, validated, tx_json, and other XRPL submission fields.
submission.title: Submission
